summary.name: Wepik AI Image Generator
summary.one_liner: A text-to-image AI generator built into the Wepik online graphic design editor, which turns written prompts into images using Stable Diffusion.
use_cases: Creating art and illustrations from prompts
Making visuals for presentations or projects
Inserting AI images into design templates
summary.what_it_does: The AI Image Generator takes a text prompt describing the desired image and produces images, with style options such as photo, digital art, 3D, or painting. Per the page, it uses Stable Diffusion technology and returns four images per prompt to choose from. Generated images can be edited in Wepik's built-in photo editor (adjustment sliders, background remover, filters, resize, flip, crop) and inserted into its template library. The page also includes a gallery of example prompts and images and guidance on writing prompts.
notable: Powered by Stable Diffusion, per the page
Built into a graphic design editor with templates, photo editor and background remover
caveats: Only 10 free image generations after registration; further use requires choosing a paid credit plan
Page says it is optimized for desktop browsers; mobile browser use is possible but secondary
